findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_round, launch_options, search_prizes, prepare_launch, submit_launch, launch_status, submit_split, my_wins, claim_sol, get_holders · Private data: sign_in_challenge, sign_in, launch_options, search_prizes, prepare_launch, submit_launch, launch_status, submit_split, quote_trade, build_trade, send_transaction, my_wins, claim_sol, create_coin_key, revoke_coin_key, set_coin_mode, award_prize · Public sink: sign_in_challenge, sign_in, launch_options, search_prizes, prepare_launch, submit_launch, launch_status, submit_split, quote_trade, build_trade, send_transaction, claim_sol, create_coin_key, revoke_coin_key · Destructive: create_coin_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_round, launch_options, search_prizes, prepare_launch, submit_launch, launch_status, submit_split, my_wins, claim_sol, get_holders · Private data: sign_in_challenge, sign_in, launch_options, search_prizes, prepare_launch, submit_launch, launch_status, submit_split, quote_trade, build_trade, send_transaction, my_wins, claim_sol, create_coin_key, revoke_coin_key, set_coin_mode, award_prize · Public sink: sign_in_challenge, sign_in, launch_options, search_prizes, prepare_launch, submit_launch, launch_status, submit_split, quote_trade, build_trade, send_transaction, claim_sol, create_coin_key, revoke_coin_key · Destructive: create_coin_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
